correctness.rationale: After removing two independent global phases, f,g are nowhere-zero unit-modulus length-three words. A unimodular triple has vanishing DFT iff its three entries form a common scalar times an F3 character: each row V_g f(x,.) is therefore either fully nonzero or has precisely two zeros. The exceptional condition is f(t)=omega^(jt)g(t-x)/g(-x), defining nine 2-tori. Distinct slopes in one x cannot coexist. For distinct x,y, their simultaneous conditions force g(t)/g(t-1)=c omega^(ht), c^3=1, so g(t)=omega^(at^2+bt) and f(t)=omega^(jt)g(t); all three x then exceptional. Exactly 27 triple points, each cross-x torus pair intersects in three points. Hence supports exactly 3,7,9. For q divisible by three, each torus has q^2 normalized points; inclusion/exclusion of 27 triple intersections yields support counts 27, 9q^2-81 and q^4-9q^2+54 for EVERY q>=3 divisible by3. Independent exact exponent-congruence enumeration for q=3,6,9 gives (27,0,54), (27,243,1026), (27,648,5886). Infinite alphabet formula comes from the geometric argument, not the finite tests.
residual_risks: The result is specific to length three; no general-p support enumeration is claimed.
